login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Enter your credentials to access the AltaStor console.

twoFactor.title: Enter your code
twoFactor.subtitle: This account uses two-factor sign-in. Open your authenticator app.
twoFactor.codeRequired: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.recoveryHint: One of the codes you saved when you set up two-factor sign-in. Each works once.

login.recoveryCodeUsed_one: Signed in with a recovery code. {{count}} is left.
login.recoveryCodeUsed_other: Signed in with a recovery code. {{count}} are left.

changePassword.title: Update your password
changePassword.subtitle: This account is using a temporary password. Choose a new one to continue.
changePassword.tooShort: Password must be at least {{count}} characters.

credentials.title: Those credentials weren’t accepted
credentials.desc: The username and password don’t match an account on this appliance. Check both, then try again.

code.title: That code wasn’t accepted
code.desc: Enter the code the app shows now. A code works once, so if you just used it, wait for the next one. If codes keep failing, check that the clocks on your phone and on the appliance are right.

recoveryCode.title: That recovery code wasn’t accepted
recoveryCode.desc: It isn’t one of this account’s recovery codes, or it was already used. Each code works once; codes from before a new set was made no longer work.

currentWrong.title: That password wasn’t accepted
currentWrong.desc: The appliance didn’t recognise the password for this account. Check it, then try again.

locked.title: Sign-in is blocked for a few minutes
locked.desc: Too many failed attempts on this account. Wait a few minutes, then try again.

disabled.title: This account can't sign in
disabled.desc: The account is disabled or holds no valid role. An Administrator can enable it or assign a role in Settings → Users.

policy.title: That password doesn’t meet the appliance’s policy
policy.desc: The appliance won’t accept it as written. Ask an administrator to reset it, then sign in with the new one.

unreachable.title: Couldn’t reach the appliance
unreachable.desc: The sign-in request never got an answer, so nothing was checked. Make sure the appliance is powered on and reachable on the network, then try again.

rejected.title: The appliance refused the sign-in
rejected.desc: It answered with a reason this console has no sentence of its own for. Its wording is below.

credentials.title: Those credentials weren’t accepted
credentials.desc: The appliance didn’t accept the current password for this account. Check it, then try again.

currentWrong.title: That’s not your current password
currentWrong.desc: The change was refused and your password is unchanged. Enter the password you signed in with.

locked.title: Too many attempts — try again shortly
locked.desc: The appliance has blocked this account for a few minutes. Your password is unchanged.

policy.title: The new password is too short
policy.desc: It doesn’t meet the appliance’s length policy, so nothing was changed. Choose a longer one.

unreachable.title: Couldn’t reach the appliance
unreachable.desc: The request never got an answer, so your password is unchanged. Make sure the appliance is reachable on the network, then try again.

rejected.title: The appliance refused the change
rejected.desc: It answered with a reason this console has no sentence of its own for, and your password is unchanged. Its wording is below.

inactivity.title: You were signed out after {{duration}} of inactivity
inactivity.titleNoDuration: You were signed out after a period of inactivity
inactivity.desc: Sign in again to continue. Settings → Security sets how long the console waits.

lifetime.title: Your session reached its time limit
lifetime.desc: Sessions end a fixed time after sign-in, whatever the activity. Sign in again to continue.

ended.title: Your session ended
ended.desc: The appliance no longer accepts it: your password may have been reset, or your account changed. Sign in again to continue.
